limitations: Normalized unit-EI bending integral over piecewise straight/R25 arcs is an optimization proxy, not a calibrated geometrically exact elastic rod.
No measured bending/torsional stiffness, clamp compliance, friction or gravity model. No force balance/KKT convergence certificate.
No continuous-motion or trajectory interpolation certificate; all poses have mouth angle 0 degrees.
Mesh boolean cutoff is 1e-5 mm3, without certified CAD tessellation Hausdorff bound.
Wire insulation may touch physically; tiny positive numerical gaps are not manufacturing tolerance.
Failed bounded solves mean no witness was found, not mathematical infeasibility.
